nodes.description: Public constant count = 4444 used as the modulo size for winner selection.
Immutable owner address initialised from msg.sender (deployer) at construction.
Public uint256 seed written once by chooseWinners() and read by winner().
Owner-only function that derives and stores a pseudo-random seed from block attributes.
View function that hashes the stored seed with an index and returns number % count.
Caller-controlled address used for the owner check in chooseWinners().
Miner-influenced block timestamp fed into the randomness seed computation.
keccak256 over block.timestamp, blockhash(number-1), coinbase, gaslimit and difficulty produces miner-manipulable randomness.
keccak256(seed,index) % count collapses the hash to a uint16 winner id between 0 and 4443.
Local uint256 inside chooseWinners() holding the computed seed hash.
Caller-supplied index parameter of winner(uint256 index).
Local uint256 inside winner() holding keccak256(randomlyChosenNumber, index).

edges.reason: The immutable owner state variable is assigned from the untrusted msg.sender at deployment, making the deployer the privileged account.
chooseWinners() gates execution on require(msg.sender == owner), so the caller controls whether the privileged path runs.
The owner state variable is compared against msg.sender inside the onlyOwner-style require of chooseWinners().
block.timestamp is packed into the seed hash, creating a timestamp-dependent (miner-influenceable) randomness source.
Execution of chooseWinners() triggers the weak randomness hash computation.
The hash result computed in the unsafe operation is stored into the local variable number.
The local seed value is written into the randomlyChosenNumber state variable.
chooseWinners() reads randomlyChosenNumber in the require check requiring an unset seed.
winner() reads the stored randomlyChosenNumber seed as the base of its hash.
Calling winner() executes the hash-and-modulo unsafe operation.
The stored seed is an input to the keccak256(seed, index) computation.
The externally supplied index parameter is packed into the hash before the modulo reduction.
The modulo result of the unsafe operation is captured in the local variable number of winner().
The local number is cast to uint16 and returned from winner().
The constant count = 4444 is the divisor used in the modulo reduction of the winner index.

normalization_plan.reason: The temporary local variable number in chooseWinners() only holds the output of the weak randomness unsafe operation and can be normalised into it.
The index parameter exists solely to be consumed by the winner() function and can be normalised into that core function.
The local variable number in winner() merely stores the modulo result of the unsafe hash operation and can be normalised into it.
